explanation: The training was called the agoge. Spartan girls also exercised, running and wrestling, and Spartan women could own land, which was rare in ancient Greece.

claims.text: Sparta took boys from their families at about the age of seven for state military training.
Athens, Corinth and Thebes had no state system that took boys from their families at about seven for military training.
The Spartan state training system was called the agoge.
Spartan girls took part in physical training such as running and wrestling.
Spartan women could own land, which was rare in ancient Greece.
